courses.title: Practical Artificial Intelligence & AI Productivity
courses.subtitle: Use AI tools confidently, check what they give you, and build routines that save real time.
courses.summary: A hands-on, jargon-free course on using AI chat and image tools for study, work and small business, safely and honestly.

courses.title: Cybersecurity & Digital Safety Fundamentals

courses.title: Data Analysis & Spreadsheet Skills

courses.summary: Learn to clean data, build formulas and PivotTables, chart honestly and report findings, using a practice café dataset that is deliberately messy.
